none: PAS CAM-F942E1: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse - no legend. Reverse shows Wolf and twins. Mint is Trier, AD330-335. Obverse legend reads [VR]BS-ROMA. Obverse shows Helmeted bust left. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TR[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 2.31g, diameter is 18.5mm, thickness is 1.93mm
